metrics.name: final_diagnosis_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the final diagnosis matches the curated ground truth.

metrics.name: recovery_at_k
metrics.description: Correct diagnosis within K diagnostic actions.

metrics.name: experiments_to_recovery
metrics.description: Number of diagnostic actions required for a correct diagnosis.

metrics.name: hypothesis_revision_accuracy
metrics.description: Appropriateness of rank changes after evidence: supported hypotheses move upward and contradicted hypotheses move downward.

metrics.name: anchoring_rate
metrics.description: Persistence of an initially top-ranked incorrect hypothesis despite contradictory evidence.

metrics.name: feedback_sensitivity
metrics.description: Changes in hypothesis rankings and action choices across feedback conditions.

metrics.name: hallucination_rate
metrics.description: Unsupported biological explanations or causal claims.

metrics.name: unnecessary_experiment_rate
metrics.description: Diagnostic actions that provide little useful information.

metrics.name: diagnostic_efficiency
metrics.description: Useful uncertainty reduction within the diagnostic budget.
